_comment: The Revised Babycare sheet repeats the five category labels in four blocks (shipped GMV, units, ASP, GMV %). 'sections' name a block by the prefix of the row that opens it (first match wins, so 'shr' is listed before 'gmv'); a rule 'section::label' applies only inside that block. Kids Fashion carries 293 (GMV) and 3140 (ASP) in the sheet; the webform reports it as 457/1551 (GMV) and 473/514 (ASP), which the babycare step fills.
